outcome: duration of the active phase of labor
duration of the second phase of labor
cohort: 120 mothers admitted to the maternity ward of Firoozabadi Hospital for delivery
finding: Spinal anesthesia can be used as a low-complication method in vaginal delivery to reduce pain.
mod_finding: Five mothers (4.2%) who received spinal anesthesia underwent emergency cesarean section, and the duration of the second phase of labor was significantly longer in the mothers who received spinal anesthesia.
